originalFrozenTask.learnerTask: Trace a branched signaling relay while distinguishing kinases, switches and scaffolds from measured downstream effects.
originalFrozenTask.gap: The relay analogy is useful but no map shows the branching circuit or the distinction between a named phosphosite response and later cell-count response. A compact causal map would make the non-kinase RAS example and disconnected inference clearer.
accuracyGuardrails: Do not draw every relay as a kinase or every phosphate as activating.
A generic circuit is a possible connection map, not measured wiring in every tumor.
A biochemical response does not establish growth dependence.

generatorCustody: Original generator privately retained, not publicly delivered; editable SVG without an executable reproduction-package promise.
sourceDepth: Actual primary abstracts and selected primary/official passages; exact per-owner private lookup/depth/failure/custody receipts. No whole-paper/clinical/scientific approval implied.
themeMethod: Exact shared geometry and wording, palette substitutions only
